Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash an Option card in the battle area that belongs to either me or my opponent?
Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when an Option card in the battle area that belongs to either me or my opponent is trashed?
